The finance department at LuxFunds is experiencing significant operational inefficiencies due to its reliance on paper-based processes for expense reporting and approval. The primary bottleneck is the manual nature of these workflows, which directly causes a backlog of unprocessed claims and delayed reimbursements. This delay contributes to employee dissatisfaction and introduces a higher risk of human error during data entry. To improve efficiency, LuxFunds should transition to a digital expense management system. Automating the submission, approval, and reimbursement processes would eliminate the backlog, reduce processing time, minimize errors, and enhance the overall employee experience.
